response.explanation: Average latency of failed attempts by failure category, with the window capped at 400 days (2025-10-02 to 2026-10-31) because the validator rejects the full two-year span.
response.sql: SELECT failure_category, AVG(latency_ms) AS avg_latency_ms, COUNT(*) AS failed_attempts FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-02' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01' AND status <> 'SUCCESS' AND failure_category IN ('customer_dropoff', 'issuer_decline', 'technical', 'risk_decline') GROUP BY failure_category ORDER BY failure_category LIMIT 50
